items.titleZh: COVID-19疫情前后英格兰高安动脉炎的发病率和患病率：来自RECORDER研究的结果
items.abstractZh: 高安动脉炎（TAK）是一种罕见的大血管炎，与显著的发病率和死亡率相关。关于其流行病学证据（包括COVID-19疫情的影响）尚不完整。我们旨在利用全国常规收集的医疗数据描述英格兰TAK的发病率和患病率。利用英格兰全境的医院统计（住院患者护理和门诊），我们确定了所有具有国际疾病分类第十版TAK代码的患者。我们在五个国家卫生服务信托机构以及使用帝国理工学院123例确诊TAK的独特队列中验证了我们的病例确定和诊断日期细化策略。我们计算了2006年至2023年英格兰TAK的发病率（队列设计），特别关注COVID-19疫情，以及2022年7月1日的点患病率（横断面设计）。结果按关键人口统计学变量报告。英格兰TAK的发病率为每年每百万人1.3例（95% CI 1.3, 1.4），且保持稳定，但2020-2021年（COVID-19疫情）下降了30%。2022年年中的TAK患病率为每百万人22.5例（95% CI 21.3, 23.8）。诊断时的中位年龄为53岁。女性和亚洲/亚裔英国人及其他族裔群体的发病率和患病率均较高。不同地理区域之间存在差异，但社会经济地位没有显著影响。英格兰有近1300人患有TAK，除COVID-19疫情期间外，每年新增病例超过70例。这些估计基于比以往欧洲研究大10倍的队列，将对规划和大流行准备的专科服务至关重要。

items.title: Global burden of gout attributable to high BMI (1990-2021) and causal link with obesity: a GBD and Mendelian randomization study.
items.abstract: High body mass index (BMI ⩾25 kg/m 2 ) is a critical driver of the global gout epidemic. We aimed to characterize the evolving burden of gout attributable to high BMI and establish the potential causal links between varying obesity grades and gout risk. We aimed to characterize the evolving burden of gout attributable to high BMI and establish the potential causal links between varying obesity grades and gout risk. An observational global epidemiological analysis and a bidirectional two-sample Mendelian randomization (MR) study. Utilizing Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 data, we analyzed disability-adjusted life years (DALYs) and age-standardized DALY rates across 204 countries. Trends were assessed via Joinpoint regression, decomposition, and inequality analyses. Future trajectories were projected using Bayesian age-period-cohort models. Bidirectional MR evaluated the causal impact of Class 1-3 obesity on gout, adjusting for multiple comparisons. From 1990 to 2021, global DALYs for high BMI-related gout increased 2.26-fold, with a 56.9% rise in age-standardized DALY rates. While High-socio-demographic index (SDI) regions face the highest absolute burden, the fastest growth occurred in low-middle SDI regions, indicating a geographic shift. A significant "age-shift" was observed, with the burden increasingly affecting younger males. Epidemiological changes were the primary drivers. MR analysis provided evidence supporting a potential causal relationship between Class 1 and 3 obesity and gout (all odds ratios > 1), with no evidence of reverse causality. Projections suggest that the global age-standardized DALY rates will reach 7.1 per 100,000 by 2040. The global burden of high BMI-related gout is escalating, driven by epidemiological transitions and rising risks in younger men. Genetic evidence supports weight management as a fundamental preventive pillar. Targeted interventions, particularly in rapidly urbanizing regions, are urgently needed to curb this health threat. Not applicable. How excess body weight is driving a global rise in gout: understanding the trends from 1990 to 2021 and the direct link between obesity and joint pain Gout is a highly painful form of arthritis caused by the buildup of uric acid crystals in the joints. While it is well known that carrying extra body weight is linked to gout, our study aimed to understand exactly how much of the global gout problem is driven by excess weight, and to prove whether obesity directly causes the disease. To do this, we examined health data from 204 countries spanning over 30 years (from 1990 to 2021). We also used a specialized scientific method that looks at human genetics to act like a natural experiment, allowing us to confidently test if being overweight directly leads to gout. We discovered that the global health impact of gout linked to high body weight has more than doubled since 1990. While wealthy nations currently have the highest number of cases, the fastest growth is now happening in developing countries. Alarmingly, our research revealed a major shift: gout is increasingly striking much younger men than it did in the past. Furthermore, our genetic analysis provided strong proof that excess body weight directly causes gout. We found that as the level of obesity increases, the risk of developing gout goes up significantly. Importantly, we confirmed that this relationship is a one-way street—while obesity causes gout, having gout does not cause a person to gain weight. Why does this matter? Our findings show that the global rise in gout is largely preventable. Because excess weight is the starting point for the disease, managing body weight through healthy eating and active lifestyles is the most important step in preventing and treating gout. Public health policies and doctors must urgently focus on weight management, especially for younger men, to help curb this painful and growing global health threat.

items.title: Calcinosis Cutis as the Leading Manifestation of Juvenile Dermatomyositis: A Case Report.
items.abstract: Juvenile dermatomyositis (JDM) is a rare autoimmune inflammatory myopathy of childhood. Initial manifestations may be atypical and lead to delays in diagnosis. An 11-year-old boy with a history of trauma of the left knee was initially treated with systemic antibiotics without clinical improvement. On physical examination, ulcerated plaques composed of multiple fistulous tracts with abundant purulent discharge were observed. A skin biopsy revealed findings consistent with calcinosis cutis. The autoantibody panel was positive for anti-Mi-2 antibodies, along with elevated muscle enzymes (CK = 2892 U/L). A diagnosis of JDM was established, and systemic treatment with prednisone at 1 mg/kg/day was initiated, resulting in an adequate clinical response of the lesions. JDM is a rare condition with a variable clinical presentation in the pediatric population. This case highlights the importance of considering JDM in the differential diagnosis of patients presenting with calcinosis, even in the absence of classic cutaneous manifestations and with only subtle or initially unrecognized muscle involvement.

items.titleZh: 钙质沉着症作为幼年型皮肌炎的主要表现：一例病例报告。
items.abstractZh: 幼年型皮肌炎（JDM）是一种罕见的儿童自身免疫性炎症性肌病。初始表现可能不典型，导致诊断延迟。一名有左膝外伤史的11岁男孩最初接受全身性抗生素治疗，但临床未改善。体格检查观察到由多个瘘管组成的溃疡性斑块，伴有大量脓性分泌物。皮肤活检显示与皮肤钙质沉着症一致的表现。自身抗体检测抗Mi-2抗体阳性，同时肌酶升高（CK = 2892 U/L）。确诊为JDM，开始使用泼尼松1 mg/kg/天全身治疗，皮损获得充分的临床反应。JDM是一种罕见疾病，在儿科人群中临床表现多样。本病例强调了在出现钙质沉着症的患者鉴别诊断中考虑JDM的重要性，即使没有典型的皮肤表现，且仅有轻微或最初未被识别的肌肉受累。
